mapper.sql:
select sdi.* from sys_dict_item sdi left join sys_dict sd on sdi.dict_id = sd.id and sd.deleted = 0 where sdi.deleted = 0
and ( sd.tenant_id = #{tenantId} or ( sd.tenant_id = 0 and sd.source_scope = 'PUBLIC_SYSTEM' ) )
and sdi.dict_id = #{dictId}
and sdi.dict_key = #{dictKey}
and sdi.item_value like concat('%', #{itemValue}, '%')
and sdi.label like concat('%', #{label}, '%')
and sdi.description like concat('%', #{description}, '%')
order by sdi.sort_order asc, sdi.created_time desc, sdi.id desc
